basics.name: Oskari Laakso
basics.label: Senior Software Developer and Architect, Agile Practitioner
basics.summary:
Oskari brings deep technical expertise and a strong business mindset to every project. He has successfully designed and delivered complex software solutions across the public sector, finance, energy, and mobility domains. Oskari combines a rock-solid foundation in Java and JEE with modern web technologies. Today, his development practices are increasingly centered on AI-assisted programming.

Beyond his technical skills, Oskari offers a future-oriented perspective grounded in his master’s studies in sustainable futures and foresight. He approaches software development with a broad foresight mindset, anticipating how client environments and needs will evolve over time. His thesis work on AI-assisted foresight methods highlights his ability to blend modern technology with strategic insights to build sustainable, future-proof solutions.
basics.x-tagline: When resources are scarce, real impact depends as much on what we decide to leave unbuilt as on what we actually build.

projects.name: RAG-based AI assistant for public sector officials
projects.description: Acted as a Senior Software Developer, collaborating closely with a Data Engineer to build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that serves as an intelligent AI assistant for public sector officials. Focused on software and application development to leverage Natural Language Processing (NLP) and generative AI, ultimately streamlining document processing and enhancing decision-making workflows for government handlers.

projects.name: Pricing management system
projects.description: Acted as the Lead Full-Stack Developer, Architect, and Scrum Master for a comprehensive pricing management system. Held end-to-end responsibility, from senior-level application architecture design and microservices implementation to managing deployment processes and maintaining the system in production. Guided, coached, and mentored junior developers within a diverse, multicultural, and international team environment. Ensured smooth Agile project execution and active collaboration across geographic boundaries. Actively utilized AI-assisted coding tools to optimize development workflows and code quality.
